subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Does the documented failed extraction satisfy this investigation's stop condition, or should one different bounded route-boundary experiment be sponsored?
rationale: The issue explicitly permits stopping after a non-material first extraction, while current main still has the underlying coupling; choosing whether further performance work is worthwhile is a prioritization decision rather than a defined code defect.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the measured negative result as satisfying the issue's stop condition and close the investigation without code changes.

options.title: Sponsor one new experiment
options.body: Keep the issue active with a newly specified import boundary, current-main baseline, material byte target, and waterfall constraints.
